log.text: Floette used Light of Ruin → Gholdengo
Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Arcanine

decisions.rationale: Mega Floette intended. Lead Floette+Arcanine: Fairy Aura deletes Hydreigon/Farig; Intimidate+Fire/Rock pressures Gholdengo/Corv. Back Maushold Friend Guard/Follow Me enables glass, Annihilape Defiant Rage Fist answers Ghost/Steel after chips. Bascu/Pult flex vs remaining Water/Ghost.
decisions.notebook: Opp: Gholdengo LO Modest GoodasGold; Farigiraf MentalHerb Calm ArmorTail TR; Corv Lefties Impish MirrorArmor Tailwind; Gliscor Sash Jolly HyperCutter; RotomW Sitrus Timid Levitate; Hydreigon Scarf Timid Levitate. My plan: Mega Floette Fairy Aura; Arcanine LO Intimidate; Ape Sitrus Defiant; Pult Sash Infiltrator; Maushold WideLens FriendGuard; Bascu Belt Adaptability. Hard hitters over stall. Lead Fairy/Fire vs their cores; redirect+Ape clean.

decisions.rationale: Lead Gholdengo+Corviknight: Tailwind ensures my faster special attackers outrun Floette/Dragapult. Gholdengo walls Fairy moves and OHKOs Floette (2x Steel). Back Hydreigon+Rotom-Wash clean after Tailwind. Intended Mega: none (opponent's Floette-Eternal is the Mega). Farigiraf saved for late Trick Room if Tailwind fades.
decisions.notebook: Game1: Lead Gholdengo+Corviknight Tailwind. Flash Cannon at ~74% min vs Floette. Corviknight walls Arcanine-H Flare Blitz (resists Rock via Steel) and Basculegion Wave Crash. Gliscor+Farigiraf backline not chosen but available next games. Opponent likely leads Floette+Maushold to Follow Me + Light of Ruin; Maushold Friend Guard reduces damage but Gholdengo resists Fairy and can Protect stall. Dragapult Focus Sash survives 1 hit; Hydreigon Dark Pulse range 55-123% (Sash blocks OHKO).

selection: Light of Ruin -> foe 1 (Gholdengo) + Mega Evolve
decisions.rationale: Mega for Fairy Aura; LoR pressures LO Gholdengo (resists Fairy but Aura+LO chip). FB KOs or heavily damages Corv through MirrorArmor bounce risk on Intimidate already done. Speed: we outspeed both. Avoid ES into Ghost. Protect less needed T1 vs likely Tailwind.
Bring Annihilape for Defiant boost vs likely MakeItRain/steel and Fighting STAB into Gholdengo; Corv 40% dies to Blitz next. Maushold FriendGuard less urgent now.

Flash Cannon is a guaranteed OHKO on Floette (126% vs 126 HP) unless it Protects; Tailwind secures speed edge for future turns. Make It Rain drops SpA and barely scratches Arcanine (0.25x). Doubling Floette is overkill if it doesn't Protect and wastes a turn if it does. Corviknight tanks Flare Blitz at -1 (33% max) and Floette's resisted Fairy hits (27% max).
decisions.notebook: Game1: Lead Gholdengo+Corviknight. Floette has Protect, so Flash Cannon may be blocked. Arcanine at -1 Atk from Mirror Armor bounce. Tailwind vs speed: Gholdengo 136, Floette 123–158, Arcanine 121–156. Opponent bench: Annihilape (Defiant), Dragapult (Focus Sash), Maushold (Wide Lens, Friend Guard), Basculegion (Adaptability, Expert Belt). Next game: consider Gliscor+Farigiraf to punish Defiant/set Trick Room.

decisions.rationale: Corv at 40% dies to LO Flare Blitz; Ape Rage Fist (base 50, +1 hit) 2x KO range on 90% Ghold under LO. Both outspeed under TW only if we don't Protect. ES immune on Ghold. Clear both threats before TW snowballs; Defiant if Intim reflected useless.
decisions.notebook: Opp: Gholdengo LO Modest GoodasGold; Farigiraf MentalHerb Calm ArmorTail TR; Corv Lefties Impish MirrorArmor Tailwind; Gliscor Sash Jolly HyperCutter; RotomW Sitrus Timid Levitate; Hydreigon Scarf Timid Levitate. My plan: Mega Floette Fairy Aura; Arcanine LO Intimidate; Ape Sitrus Defiant; Pult Sash Infiltrator; Maushold WideLens FriendGuard; Bascu Belt Adaptability. Hard hitters over stall. Lead Fairy/Fire vs their cores; redirect+Ape clean. Floette died T1 to Flash Cannon after LoR miss.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Corviknight at 41% is KO'd by Arcanine Flare Blitz (68.8-148.6% super-effective). Roost removes Flying type, making Fire neutral (0.5x) and cutting damage 4x — Corviknight survives. Gholdengo's Shadow Ball (78.8-138.9%, Life Orb) likely OHKOs Annihilape or leaves it in Sitrus range. Double-targeting Annihilape is overkill and risks Brave Bird recoil on low HP Corviknight. Roost + Shadow Ball handles both threats safely under Tailwind speed advantage.
decisions.notebook: Game1: Lead Gholdengo+Corviknight vs Floette+Arcanine. Floette has Protect. Arcanine Intimidate bounced by Mirror Armor (-1 Atk). Tailwind active T2. Bench: Annihilape (Defiant, Sitrus), Dragapult (Sash), Maushold (WideLens, FriendGuard), Basculegion (Adaptability, ExpertBelt). Next game: consider Gliscor+Farigiraf to punish Defiant and control speed.

decisions.rationale: Corv 35% dies to HH-boosted LO Flare Blitz through -1; Gholdengo outspeeds and Make It Rain threatens both but Friend Guard + HH KO removes Tailwind setter now. ES/Bomb useless into Steel. Protect stalls Tailwind but leaves Corv healthy.

Tailwind active makes Gholdengo fastest. Make It Rain KOs Arcanine (37.9-69.7% after FriendGuard vs 31% HP) and damages Maushold. Corviknight Protects to block both Flare Blitz and Population Bomb safely. This wins the game on the turn if Maushold faints, or forces a favorable 2v1 next turn.
decisions.notebook: Game1 opp has Defiant Annihilape+Sitrus, Dragapult+Sash, Maushold+WideLens+FriendGuard, Basculegion+Adaptability+ExpertBelt. Floette Mega is dead. Opponent leads openers reactively; consider leading Ghost types to block Normal spam and strong Ground moves for Arcanine next game.

decisions.rationale: Only Maushold acts; Gholdengo immune to Bomb. Chip Corv with Wide Lens Pop Bomb before likely KO; Tidy/Follow waste. No switch menu. Tailwind ends after.
Maushold 12% HP, no allies left. Flash Cannon 100% acc and guaranteed KO. Corviknight Roosts to heal safely. Only threat is Population Bomb on Corviknight but it's resisted and can't KO. End game 1.
decisions.notebook: Game1 won. Opponent sets seen: Annihilape (Defiant, Sitrus, Jolly; moves RageFist/CloseCombat/DrainPunch/Protect), Floette-Mega (Fairy Aura, Light of Ruin/Moonblast/Protect/GigaDrain), Arcanine-Hisui (Intimidate, LifeOrb, Jolly; Flare Blitz/HeadSmash/ExtremeSpeed/Protect), Maushold (WideLens, FriendGuard, Jolly; Population Bomb/FollowMe/HelpingHand/TidyUp). Dragapult (FocusSash, Timid; ShadowBall/DracoMeteor/Thunderbolt/Protect) and Basculegion (ExpertBelt, Adaptability, Adamant; LastRespects/WaveCrash/AquaJet/Protect) unused. Opponent leads reactively; consider leading Ghost types to block Normal/Fighting. Tailwind only 1 turn left this game.

reflections.summary: Lost due to flawed team-preview: Mega Floette + Arcanine lead was autolost into Gholdengo/Corv (Steel resists + SE Flash Cannon, Mirror Armor, Tailwind); LoR miss + immediate KO ended it with zero pilot errors.
reflections.adjustment: Drop Floette entirely next game vs this core; bring Ape/Maushold/Arcanine + Pult or Bascu, lead Intimidate + redirect or scarf pressure instead of Fairy Aura.
reflections.notebook: Opp: Gholdengo LO Modest GoodasGold (FlashCannon/MakeItRain/ShadowBall/Protect); Corv Lefties Impish MirrorArmor (Tailwind/Roost/IronHead/BraveBird); Farigiraf MentalHerb Calm ArmorTail TR; Gliscor Sash Jolly HyperCutter; RotomW Sitrus Timid Levitate; Hydreigon Scarf Timid Levitate. Leads Ghold+Corv Tailwind. My plan: ditch Mega Floette vs their Steels; hard hitters (Ape Defiant Sitrus, Arcanine LO Intim, Maushold WideLens FriendGuard, Pult/Bascu) over Fairy Aura; redirect+Ape clean, pressure Corv before Tailwind.

reflections.summary: Won by exploiting opponent's risky turn 1: Floette-Mega missed Light of Ruin on Gholdengo, allowing Gholdengo to KO Floette with Flash Cannon. Tailwind from Corviknight gave speed advantage, and Gholdengo's Shadow Ball KO'd Annihilape turn 2. Opponent's Arcanine and Maushold were cleaned up without threatening a comeback. Key factor: opponent's reliance on inaccurate moves and lack of Protect on Floette.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, consider leading with a faster Ghost type (e.g., Dragapult) to block Arcanine's ExtremeSpeed and Maushold's Population Bomb. Alternatively, bring Basculegion to threaten Last Respects after early KOs. Ensure Protect on key mons to scout or avoid critical hits. Opponent may adjust leads to avoid similar early collapse.
reflections.notebook: Opponent's Floette-Mega is risky with Light of Ruin (90% accuracy); can miss crucial KOs. Arcanine-Hisui is Life Orb, Jolly, with Flare Blitz/HeadSmash/ExtremeSpeed/Protect; Intimidate triggers Mirror Armor. Maushold is Wide Lens, Friend Guard, Jolly; uses FollowMe/HelpingHand to support. Annihilape is Defiant, Sitrus, Jolly; moves RageFist/CloseCombat/DrainPunch/Protect. Dragapult (Focus Sash, Timid) and Basculegion (Expert Belt, Adaptability, Adamant) unused. Opponent leads reactively; consider leading Ghost types to block Normal/Fighting. Tailwind only 1 turn left this game; plan for speed control without it next game.
